taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Monokpo-street (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1426 | 2.2 | 2.2
2 | 569 | 0.998 | 3.2
3 | 1241 | 23.2 | 26.4
4 | 1931 | 30.1 | 56.5
5 | 2994 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as Q-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Monokpo-street (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: Q-type
Aquifer depth: 26.4 m – >56.5 m (Layers 4 and 5)
Recommendation: Target the resistive sandy sequence beginning below 26.4 m depth, screening through Layer 4 and into the underlying high-resistivity Layer 5; drill to at least 60 m to ensure adequate penetration of the main water-bearing unit, while casing off the shallow low-resistivity clayey zone (2.2–3.2 m) to prevent contamination.
